title: A New 210-Million-Year-Old Dinosaur Found by a Zimbabwe Lake

scenes.text: A new dinosaur was just found on a lake shore in Zimbabwe.
It's called Musango, and it lived about two hundred and ten million years ago.
It was about fifteen feet long and weighed around five hundred pounds.
It walked on two legs and was still growing when it died.
It belongs to the family that led to the giant long-necked dinosaurs.
It lived beside a close relative that looked different.
Scientists say at least one more species is waiting to be described.

description:
A new dinosaur was just found on the shore of a lake in Zimbabwe.
Musango lived about 210 million years ago, was about 15 feet long, and belongs to the family that led to the giant long-necked dinosaurs.
What will they find next?
first_comment: Bonus: researchers say another species from the same site is still waiting to be named. What would you call it?
